source_text: Fail loudly and early: a silent failure or swallowed error becomes a production mystery; an explicit error is a diagnosable event.
pattern: Fail loudly and early: a silent failure or swallowed error becomes a production mystery; an explicit error is a diagnosable event.
reason: Silent failures are the hardest to fix.

source_text: Make side-effecting operations idempotent; retries, webhooks, and queues will deliver the same event more than once.
pattern: Make side-effecting operations idempotent; retries, webhooks, and queues will deliver the same event more than once.
reason: Duplicate delivery is a fact of distributed systems.

source_text: Every external call needs a timeout and a retry policy with backoff; unbounded waits turn a slow dependency into a full outage.
pattern: Every external call needs a timeout and a retry policy with backoff; unbounded waits turn a slow dependency into a full outage.
reason: Without timeouts, slowness cascades into downtime.

source_text: You cannot fix what you cannot see: metrics, structured logs, and traces are features, not afterthoughts.
pattern: You cannot fix what you cannot see: metrics, structured logs, and traces are features, not afterthoughts.

source_text: Prefer graceful degradation over hard failure; a feature that returns a partial or cached result beats a 500 that takes the whole service down.
pattern: Prefer graceful degradation over hard failure; a feature that returns a partial or cached result beats a 500 that takes the whole service down.
